common.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to completely reset the CV? All data will be deleted.

preview.attribution: Show a link to our site on your CV to support the project?

install.title: Install OnlineCV on your device
install.intro: Once installed, OnlineCV opens as its own app — no browser needed.
install.offline: Works without internet — edit your CV and download the PDF offline.
install.private: All your data stays on your device only.
install.quick: One tap from your home screen.

emptyState.noItems: No data has been added yet. Click the "Add" button to get started.

wizard.title: CV creation form
wizard.welcome: Fill in the key details that will appear on your CV. Once these are done, you will complete the rest in the full CV editor.

avatar.title: Edit profile picture
avatar.step1: Click the "Choose a picture" button and select a suitable image from your device.
avatar.step2: Adjust the frame by moving, zooming and rotating the image.
avatar.step3: Click the "Add" button to save the image.
avatar.tooLarge: The image size cannot exceed 10 MB. Choose a smaller image.

templatePicker.title: Choose a template
templatePicker.atsSafeHint: This template is single-column, image-free and text-based — it is suitable for ATS systems.

export.disabledReason: To download the PDF, you must enter a first name, last name and a valid email address.
export.error: An error occurred while generating the PDF. Please try again.

errorPage.title: System error 😢
errorPage.body: Unfortunately, a system error has occurred. Please try reloading the page.

seo.title: OnlineCV — Create a free online CV
seo.description: Online platform for CV preparation. Prepare your CV in a few minutes for free and download it as a PDF.
